note: Harmony rules for the two neon slots. hueOffset is the target hue distance (CIELCh degrees) between primary and secondary neon, tolerance is how strict. darkTint picks what hue the facade should lean toward: primary, secondary, complement (opposite of primary), between (midpoint of both neons) or cool (blue-black).

schemes.label: Complementary clash
schemes.note: Opposite neons, maximum pop. The classic magenta and cyan look.

schemes.label: Split complementary
schemes.note: Near-opposite neons, slightly softer than a straight clash.

schemes.label: Triadic accent
schemes.note: Neons a third of the wheel apart, facade pulls toward the missing third.

schemes.label: Analogous glow
schemes.note: Neighbouring neons that bleed into each other, facade tinted the same way. Moody and cohesive.

schemes.label: Single-hue glow
schemes.note: One dominant light colour in two intensities, very cinematic.
